headline: Banco de Bogotá Warns of Colombian GDP Slowdown and Stagflation Risk
summary: Banco de Bogotá warned of an economic slowdown and stagflation risks as Colombian GDP grew by 0.5% in the third quarter while inflation rose to 6.3%.
why: Monitoring inflation and growth dynamics is critical for assessing sovereign credit risk and monetary policy direction in Latin American economies.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Stagflation signals and low GDP growth reflect a challenging macroeconomic backdrop for local assets.
